seo.title: About
seo.description: Since 2008 Spark Systems has built software, web, mobile and cloud platforms that governments, events and enterprises across the Middle East depend on every day.

intro.statement: For 18+ years we've built software, web, mobile and cloud platforms that governments, events and enterprises depend on every day, from New Cairo, Sheikh Zayed, Riyadh and Dubai.

mvv.title: Shaping the future of digital design

steps.label: Mission

image.alt: Modern office interior with black furniture and pendant lights

steps.text: Intelligent solutions that work from day one, and every day after.

steps.label: Vision

image.alt: Modern office building with glass windows

steps.text: A trusted digital partner, empowering businesses through technology and design that create lasting impact.

image.alt: Colleagues working together in a modern office

values.title: Always delivered
values.body: What we ship holds under real pressure.

values.title: Built to think
values.body: Every solution predicts, recommends and answers.

values.title: Straight answers
values.body: Honest about what it takes, from day one.

milestones.title: Founded in Cairo
milestones.body: Spark Systems starts as a small engineering team building custom software for enterprises in Egypt.

milestones.title: First national platform
milestones.body: A government platform goes live for millions of users and sets the standard for everything after it.

milestones.title: Riyadh office
milestones.body: We move closer to our Saudi clients as work grows across ticketing, events and public services.

milestones.title: Events at scale
milestones.body: Ticketing and accreditation for some of the region's largest seasons, venues and sporting clubs.

milestones.title: Dubai office
milestones.body: A fourth office extends our reach into the UAE.

milestones.title: AI in every product
milestones.body: AI becomes part of every platform we ship: prediction, recommendation and plain-language answers.

milestones.title: 600+ projects
milestones.body: Four offices, three countries and over a hundred organisations depending on what we build.

partnerships.title: Spark Systems partnered with AWS and Azure for secure solutions.
